2. Encord Workflow: Oscar outlines Encord's customizable workflows, including data ingestion from customer cloud storage, human evaluation, peer review, and integration of models (agents) for pre-labeling or judging. 
3. PDF Annotation Demo: Oscar demonstrates annotating a multi-page PDF report, showing how to grade quality (global or page-specific), highlight specific text (e.g., hallucinations), and automatically extract text.

5. Multimodal Support: Will and Oscar highlight Encord's support for various data modalities (video, text, image, audio) and demonstrate audio transcription and diarization with language switching. 
6. Agent Force Relevance: Will connects Encord's capabilities to potential use cases for Salesforce's "agent force" by enriching data from various sources (audio, emails, public sources) to support sales or go-to-market functions. 
7. Project Flexibility: Oscar and Will explain how projects can be set up with custom UIs, broken into specific pieces, and use nested attributes to capture deep, detailed feedback beyond simple binary answers. 
8. LLMs as Judges: Encord supports workflows where LLMs can act as judges, with humans providing the final review step, offering flexibility in project setup. 
9. Positive Customer Feedback: Jiaxin expresses that the platform seems very helpful, fancy, and capable of improving efficiency and effectiveness compared to their current tools.
